Hi Lydia —

Thanks for the heads up and congrats on the launch — great to hear. I pulled together three practical paths below so you can pick which fits Ledgerly best. High level: we can do pro-rata charges for just the remaining term, or reprice and re‑term the contract (co-term) if you want a cleaner renewal cadence.

Option 1 — Short-term uplift (fastest)
- We provision additional reserved capacity immediately (same model/shape).
- Billing: pro-rata charge for the remainder of the term (invoice next billing cycle).
- No term change.
- Typical timeline: provision within 48 hours.

Option 2 — Co-term + discounted uplift (recommended if you expect this level to persist)
- Move to a new co-term starting today for 12 months.
- We apply a 7% uplift discount on the added capacity and give preferential pricing on reserved slots.
- One amendment to sign (extends/realigns billing).
- Timeline: provisioning within 72 hours after signed amendment.

Option 3 — Staged reserved + transient credits
- Provision a temporary burst pool (30 days) + smaller permanent uplift.
- Billing: burst billed at usage rate, permanent uplift pro-rated.
- Useful if you want breathing room while you validate traffic.

Pro-rata example (Option 1) based on numbers you shared:
- Current committed spend: $120,000/yr ($10,000/mo).
- Additional reserved capacity estimate: $4,000/mo.
- Remaining term length: ~6 months (through 2026-12-31).
- Pro-rata for remainder: $4,000 * 6 = $24,000 (one-time invoice).

I attached a short proposal with line items and a draft amendment. If you’re open, I’ll loop in billing/legal to prep the amendment and send a DocuSign link.

Next step: what option do you want to pursue? If Option 2, I’ll scope the discount and new term details and cc finance.

—Olga

Lydia — quick answers inline and a proposed path to get you live before Monday if needed.

1) Invoice cadence for Option 1: we can do a one-time amendment invoice for the pro-rata amount (preferred by Procurement). Finance will generate a single invoice for $24,000 covering the uplift through the existing term.

2) 7% uplift discount for Option 2: the discount applies to the incremental uplift only (not to the historical committed base). If you choose to reprice the entire commitment we can discuss additional reductions, but standard co-term pricing gives the discount on the new capacity.

Provisioning timeline / no downtime: we will provision capacity in a new pool and route traffic—no throttling or planned downtime. Dev will be on the config.

Recommended path to unblock Monday:
- If you need capacity by Mon 12 Jul: choose Option 1 and Procurement sign the one-time amendment invoice. I’ll coordinate finance.
- If you want to move to Option 2 (co-term) and still be live ASAP: sign the amendment today and we’ll provision the uplift the same day; the discount will be applied to the incremental line item.

I’m attaching a draft amendment and a brief SOW for the reserved slots. If Procurement signs, Billing will issue the invoice and we’ll provision.

—Olga
